ruleset.name: database production quality baseline
ruleset.description:
The production gate analyses every Go package in the repository, excluding only Go test files at the command line. It runs every messgo design and code-size rule. The two excluded design rules are Go-specific false positives: process termination is permitted at the executable boundary and len() is O(1) for slices.
The explicit code-size values are the adoption baseline for existing production code. They are deliberately checked in rather than using a path exclusion or a diff-only scan: any new source in any repository Go package is analysed, and a result at or above each configured ceiling fails the gate.
